blogs.title: All Models Are Now 1.58-Bit: Why Zero Weights Make AI Smarter and Cheaper
blogs.description: This post demystifies the concept of 'ternary' weights ({-1, 0, 1}) and explains why adding a 'zero' value to traditional 1-bit models creates a powerful new standard called BitNet b1.58. We'll explore how explicitly filtering features with zeros allows these tiny models to match the intelligence of massive, full-precision giants.

blogs.title: The End of Floating Point? How Integer Addition is Crushing Energy Costs in LLMs
blogs.description: Dive into the computational revolution behind BitNet b1.58. Instead of heavy floating-point multiplications, this new architecture relies entirely on fast integer additions. Learn how this shift slashes energy consumption by over 70x and transforms the economics of running large language models on everything from data centers to your laptop.

blogs.title: Running a 70B Model on Your Laptop: The New Scaling Law for Edge AI
blogs.description: Discover the surprising math behind the new scaling laws proposed in the paper: a small 13-bit model can now outperform a massive 3-billion-parameter model while using less memory. We discuss how this breakthrough paves the way for deploying powerful LLMs on mobile phones and edge devices without sacrificing performance.
